subject: Pilot kickoff readiness — Muthrive discovery recap & next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Ahmed <lina@muthrive.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff readiness — Muthrive discovery recap & next steps

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed minimal pilot charter so we can align teams and lock a kickoff date. High level we heard:

Pain points we heard
- Search assistants frequently hallucinate product attributes; 30% incorrect responses in our sampling.
- Latency spikes on peak hours (user sessions drop when response >700ms).
- Need deterministic outputs for billing/legal content generation.

Pilot goals (60 days)
1) Reduce hallucination rate on product QA prompts to <10% on our evaluation set.
2) Maintain 95th percentile latency <350ms for 512-token flows under your peak traffic profile (approx 120 qps).
3) Produce an audit log per request with request id + prompt hash for traceability.

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- One model variant tuned for Muthrive prompt set and retrieval prefixing.
- Prompt-eval suite (200 seed prompts + golden labels) and automated regression checks.
- Access: dedicated trial capacity (small pool) + console access for your devs.
- Success gates: eval pass thresholds (see metrics above) and a production readiness checklist.

Owners and roles
- Muthrive: Lina (product lead) — decisioning; Anna (legal) — contract & data scope; Engineering lead (TBD) — infra access.
- Redwood: Markus — engagement lead; Ben — solutions engineer (infra & observability); Neha — prompt-eval lead.

Timeline / milestones (target)
- Week 0 (this week): sign off on charter + provide access info and sample data.
- Week 1: environment provisioned; initial model deployed; connectivity verified.
- Week 2–4: data ingestion, prompt-eval runs, iterate prompts.
- Week 5–8: performance tuning, latency/load testing, final acceptance run.

Immediate asks from your team (what we need to start)
1) A 3GB sample of anonymized product question logs (s3 link or secure upload).
2) AWS account IDs / IP ranges to whitelist and a short-lived service account for provisioning (instructions attached).
3) Primary engineering Slack channel or email for access ops.

Attachments: pilot charter v1 and a one-page access checklist. Please review and flag any redlines — I included a recommended no-PII clause and a short retention window for logs.

If this matches what you heard, we can pencil in Aug 24 for a kickoff call and infra handoff.

Thanks —
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Senior Manager, Solutions
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Lina Ahmed <lina@muthrive.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lee <anna.lee@muthrive.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff readiness — Muthrive discovery recap & next steps

Markus — thanks for the thorough recap. This looks good and hits the priorities we discussed. Two quick clarifications before we sign: 

1) Sample logs: we can deliver a 3GB anonymized export by Thursday (will remove PII and user ids). Our engineering lead (Miguel) is OOO until Friday — should we wait to share infra details or proceed with the account IDs now?

2) Audit logs: we need clarification on retention defaults and whether logs can be routed to our S3 (preferred). Can Redwood ship logs to an external S3, encrypted with our KMS?

Also cc'ing Anna from Legal for the retention + data scope question.

If we can get answers on these two items, I'll confirm Aug 24 for kickoff.

— Lina
Product Lead, Muthrive
lina@muthrive.com | +1 (646) 333-2244
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Ahmed <lina@muthrive.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff readiness — Muthrive discovery recap & next steps

Lina — quick answers from the ops side: 

- You can send the anonymized sample anytime; we can start parallel work on infra provisioning with placeholder IDs. If Miguel is OOO, we can still proceed with a temporary account to validate networking and whitelisting.

- Logs: yes, Redwood supports dumping request/response logs to customer-owned S3 buckets encrypted with your KMS key. We'll provide a template IAM policy and a manifest (attached: access-checklist-aws-ids.txt) — please confirm the KMS ARN when you have it.

Practical next steps I can execute this week:
1) Create a temporary trial cluster and share the IP ranges you need to whitelist.
2) Send the IAM policy + KMS template for your security team.
3) Schedule a short infra handoff with your SRE (20–30m).

If Aug 24 works for a full kickoff, I can block 30m at 9am PT for the infra handoff earlier that day.

Thanks,
Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Ahmed <lina@muthrive.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Anna Lee <anna.lee@muthrive.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff readiness — Muthrive discovery recap & next steps

Lina / Anna — 

Appreciate the quick turnaround. To confirm next steps and finalize the kickoff: 

- Lina: Aug 24 kickoff confirmed. We'll hold 9:00am PT for a 30–45m session (infra handoff + success gate alignment). If that works, Ben will send calendar invites to your team (please include Miguel once he's back).
- Anna: Ben will follow up with the IAM + KMS templates; happy to take any legal retention constraints and bake into the pilot charter.
- Action items for Muthrive before Aug 24:
  * Deliver anonymized sample export (or a drive link) by Thu, Aug 19.
  * Confirm KMS ARN or let us know if you prefer Redwood-managed logs (we'll keep them for 30 days by default).
  * Provide the SRE contact for the 9am PT handoff.

We'll update the pilot charter (attached) with the S3/KMS option and a 30-day default retention if you choose Redwood-managed logs. If you prefer a different retention window, flag it and Anna and I will coordinate to incorporate it into the statement of work.

Thanks everyone — we'll be ready to start provisioning as soon as we have the sample and KMS details.

Best,
Markus
-- End of thread --
